question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Bafflement
solution: The correct answer is '**Confusion**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The meaning of the word '**Bafflement**' is the condition of being completely unable to **understand or explain something**. (किसी चीज को समझने या समझाने में पूरी तरह असमर्थ होने की स्थिति) • For eg:- The man was left in bafflement when he witnessed the accident. • Similarly, the word **Confusion** means the state of **not being able to think clearly or not understanding something**. (स्पष्ट रूप से सोचने या कुछ समझने में सक्षम न होने की अवस्था) Hence the correct synonym to **Bafflement** is **Confusion**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Pleasure:** the feeling of being **happy** or **satisfied. **(आनंद) • **Clarity: **the quality of being **clear** and **easy to understand.** (स्पष्टता) • **Cleanliness: **being **clean** or keeping **things clean**. (स्वच्छता) 33:T977, The correct answer is '**Condemn**'.
